correctedInThisChange.before: A popularity reference could add up to 2800 score points without equipment.
correctedInThisChange.after: Meta evidence is bounded and secondary to hard skill, weapon, resource and interaction rules.

correctedInThisChange.before: Fire, cold and lightning variants could yield three simultaneous class/fallback affinity bonuses.
correctedInThisChange.after: Elemental affinity contributes at most one class/fallback match; structured ascendancy evidence remains separate.

correctedInThisChange.before: Top passive damage candidates contributed to every evaluated main skill.
correctedInThisChange.after: Only passive candidates with matching profile evidence contribute.

correctedInThisChange.before: Top damage uniques could contribute to unrelated evaluated main skills.
correctedInThisChange.after: Only current-build uniques with matching skill or profile evidence contribute.

criticalRemainingGaps.detail: The passive tree pin is older than the observed live patch family.
Conversions, ailments and damage over time, triggers, minions, projectile overlap, enemy mitigation, uptime and every skill-specific formula are not comprehensively modeled.
The local meta snapshot is observational and does not contain fully reproducible equipment, gems, passive node ids and rotation state.
The optimizer has concrete base selection for common attack weapons and selected wands, but not every current equipment family and offhand interaction.
Only 22 of 36 ascendancies currently expose productive derived tags.
Skills with several elemental or behavioral variants need variant-bound scoring instead of one broad item-level tag union.
PoB2 visible planner lines remain separated from unconfirmed GGG mod/stat identity; many uniques cannot be safely ranked beyond narrow derived semantics.
Photographs with perspective, background UI and low contrast are not reliably recognized; manual verification remains required.
